$comment: HAND-EDITED source of the Labs settings (cx-d5b5d); gen-settings-sources.py writes the Swift descriptors and parser constants. Row fields: see schemas/settings/source/updates.json.

lists.name: labs
lists.note: Settings > Advanced > Labs: surfaces still being shaped, off by default.

rows.note: Surfaces still being shaped (the agent pane's session coverage label and its Pull requests view). Off by default, so a default app shows only finished surfaces.

help.text: Unfinished surfaces, such as the agent session's coverage label and Pull requests view.

rows.note: Home as the classic top page (the Chief conversation full window) instead of the home workspace with the Chief's page in a left dock (hq-6d cx-ebm.59.5). Off by default; kept for one release. HomeDock.classic reads it through DesignSettings.classicHome.

help.text: Show Home as a full page instead of a workspace with the Chief docked on the left. Takes effect after cmux restarts.

rows.note: Unofficial Labs feature (plans/cmux-next/voice-room-DESIGN.md): Open Voice Room transcribes the mic on device, reads the screen's text on device when it changes, and posts both to the room server at labs.voiceRoomURL, whose cheap model keeps the room's memory and sends asks spoken to Chief as tasks. Off by default; while off the Voice Room actions are unavailable everywhere. The person turns it on: agents may not (not in SettingsSchema agent-writable keys).

help.text: An unofficial room where you talk with people and Chief. While a room is open, cmux transcribes your mic and reads your screen's text on this Mac, then sends that text to the room.

rows.note: The Voice Room server (experiments/voice-room). Empty is the local server, http://127.0.0.1:4788/. A tailnet room is the https://<host>.ts.net:4789/ address its `--share` prints.

help.text: The room's web address. Empty uses the room server on this Mac.

rows.note: Any machine joins with one pasted line (contract: cmux machine join, J6-J8): Add Device's "Any machine: one line" way, joined rows in the Machines sidebar with Check, Rotate and Revoke, and This Mac's Screen sharing and Control consent switches in Settings > Devices. Off by default while the join routes answer only on the development platform. The person turns it on: agents may not (not in SettingsSchema agent-writable keys).

title.text: Join Any Machine with One Line

help.text: Add Device shows a line to paste on any Mac or Linux computer; it joins your team's machines. Screen sharing and control stay off until that machine allows them.
